message:
test(picker): make the failure reproducible on demand, not only in git history

Two gaps against the completion criteria, both test-only -- the product is unchanged and
0.2.123 stands.

The before/after pair existed across two commits, which means checking out the old one
to see the failure. It is now in the same binary: the picker is drawn into the window's
own DC with nothing presented, exactly what the product used to do, and the screen keeps
showing the video while that DC holds a perfectly good picker. If that control ever
showed the picker on screen, the premise behind this whole change would be wrong.

And the picker must not stop the stream mid-session -- only the very first one, before
any selection has been revealed, holds it off. Stopping it later tore the capture down
on every peek, so checking whether the video had frozen was what froze it. With a
revealed generation set, opening the picker asks the host to stop nothing.

Also records, in the limit note, that I nearly read the verifier's independent run as a
second machine. The looser reading was available and it was the flattering one.
